malababa.title: Malababa
malababa.synopsis: A prestigious notary and a police officer have been invited and carefully walk through Doña Amelia de Blasco's estate under the dim light. Step by hesitant step, they approach the imposing mansion, unaware of the evening that awaits them. That woman, hated and feared throughout the province, arrogant, disrespectful and selfish, announces that during the dinner she has prepared she will reveal who her future heirs will be. Family members, friends and servants all have the chance to change their lives if they are chosen, and they will do anything to achieve it. But Aunt Amelia has a bad feeling. Will it change her plans at the last minute? Who truly deserves the inheritance? Let the gramophone begin to play.

cartas-a-bruno.title: Letters to Bruno
cartas-a-bruno.synopsis: An escape. A journey. A forgotten reason has brought her to the remote village of Portrush in Northern Ireland. A chain of mysterious letters and sinister events will shake her reality, forcing her to seek a way out. An ending that had already been written. What happened to Miss Lain?
